title: Add test conftest for agile tests if missing
body: If `/root/tests/agile/__init__.py` does not exist, create it as an empty file. If `/root/tests/conftest.py` already exists, skip. Check the provided tree (tests/agile/ directory exists, but no __init__.py is listed). Create `/root/tests/agile/__init__.py` empty. Target file is NEW.
